description: Validates one IBAN offline: country, expected length, ISO 7064 mod-97 check digits, whether it is inside SEPA, and the account number split out. Deterministic, no network call and no third party that can go down. Built for cleaning a list of accounts one at a time. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

iban.description: The IBAN to check. Spaces and lowercase are accepted.
